title: myrtus arbutifolia
intro: Myrtus arbutifolia, commonly known as the strawberry tree, is a plant species native to the Mediterranean region. It is a small evergreen tree or shrub that has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its numerous health benefits. The leaves and berries of Myrtus arbutifolia contain bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been reported to exhibit therapeutic actions including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The plant's leaves and berries are also said to possess health benefits such as protecting against oxidative stress, promoting cardiovascular health, and supporting the immune system.
